recognize_zh: H&E 40x 低倍可見淋巴結被大型、淡染且彼此相鄰的結節取代，結節間以細纖維帶與深染小淋巴球帶分隔，呈明顯的濾泡/結節性生長，是 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤常見的架構。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by large, pale, back-to-back nodules
Nodules separated by thin fibrous septa with small vessels and darker bands of small lymphocytes
Nodules appear homogeneous without visible polarization at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows architectural effacement by large, closely packed, pale-staining nodules separated by thin fibrovascular septa and rims of darker small lymphocytes. The nodules are homogeneous without apparent polarization. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. The nodular/follicular growth pattern, with large cell cytology and strong MUM1 expression demonstrated elsewhere, is consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: FL shows back-to-back follicles of predominantly centrocytes with BCL2 expression and t(14;18), usually without strong MUM1.
Reactive follicles vary in size and shape with polarized germinal centers and preserved sinuses and mantle zones.
NLPBL nodules are composed mainly of small lymphocytes with scattered LP cells, rather than sheets of large cells.
